t: This is Holy Trinity Church, an Anglican church on Prince Consort Road in South Kensington. The present building dates from 1901. It was built by George Frederick Bodley and Cecil Greenwood Hare. Bodley was an English Gothic Revival architect, a pupil of Sir George Gilbert Scott, who worked with C. E. Kempe. He spent much of his career in partnership with Thomas Garner, and he was one of the founders of Watts and Company. So you are standing at a late work by a leading figure of the Gothic Revival.
